meta.title: What's Your Digital Estate Worth? Free Calculator | Everstead
meta.desc: Calculate the estimated value of your estate in under 2 minutes. Free tool for UK families, includes financial accounts, property, pensions, and digital assets.

hero.sub: Enter estimated values below for an instant breakdown of your estate. Takes under 2 minutes, and could matter more than you think.

cta.title: Now make it official
cta.body: Everstead helps you document every account, nominate trusted people, and leave your family with complete clarity, all in one secure place.

disclaimer: This calculator is for estimation purposes only. Figures are approximate and should not be relied upon for legal or financial planning without professional advice. Everstead is a UK digital estate planning service, not a financial adviser.
